The client can request a presentation description via HTTP or some other method.
If the presentation is multicast, the presentation description contains the multicast addresses and ports to be used for the continuous media.
If the presentation is to be sent only to the client via unicast, the client provides the destination for security reasons.
A media server can be invited to join an existing conference to play back media into the presentation or to record all or a subset of the media in a presentation.
The invited media server can play back media into the presentation or record all or a subset of the media in a presentation.
Several parties in the conference may take turns pushing the remote control buttons.
For live presentations, it is useful if the server can tell the client about additional media becoming available.
RTSP requests may be handled by proxies, tunnels and caches as in HTTP/1.1.
The key words in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.
服务器使用单一时间线对多个流进行控制；对于音频/视频流，客户端可发送单条 play 或 pause 消息来同时控制音频和视频流。
一种可能包含多个媒体流的文件，这些流一起播放时通常构成一个呈现；RTSP 服务器可对其提供聚合控制，但容器文件概念并非内嵌于协议中。
源与汇之间存在定时关系的数据，即汇必须重现源处存在的定时关系；常见例子为音频和运动视频。
数据类型/编解码特定的初始化，包括时钟频率、颜色表等；客户端播放媒体流所需的任何传输无关信息出现在流建立的媒体初始化阶段。
特定于某种媒体类型、可在流播放之前或期间更改的参数。
提供一条或多条媒体流播放或录制服务的服务器。
单一媒体实例，例如音频流或视频流，也可以是单一白板或共享应用组。
会议成员；参与者可以是机器，例如媒体录制或播放服务器。
表示描述包含关于一个表示中的一条或多条媒体流的信息，例如编码集合、网络地址和内容信息。
RTSP 响应；如果要表示 HTTP 响应，则会明确说明。

items.meaning: An implementation MAY cache the last RTT measurement as the initial value for future connections.
items.constraint: MAY cache last RTT measurement as initial value
items.object: the last RTT measurement as the initial value for future connections

items.meaning: If a reliable transport protocol is used to carry RTSP, requests MUST NOT be retransmitted.
items.constraint: MUST NOT be retransmitted
items.condition: a reliable transport protocol is used to carry RTSP

items.meaning: If a reliable transport protocol is used to carry RTSP, the RTSP application MUST instead rely on the underlying transport to provide reliability.
items.constraint: MUST rely on underlying transport for reliability
items.object: on the underlying transport to provide reliability
items.condition: a reliable transport protocol is used to carry RTSP

items.meaning: If both the underlying reliable transport such as TCP and the RTSP application retransmit requests, each packet loss can result in two retransmissions.
items.constraint: if both transport and RTSP application retransmit requests

items.meaning: The receiver cannot typically take advantage of application-layer retransmission.
items.constraint: cannot typically take advantage

items.meaning: The transport stack will not deliver the application-layer retransmission before the first attempt has reached the receiver.
items.constraint: will not deliver before first attempt reaches receiver

items.meaning: If packet loss is caused by congestion, multiple retransmissions at different layers will exacerbate the congestion.
items.constraint: if packet loss is caused by congestion

items.meaning: Using RTSP over a small-RTT LAN can benefit from standard procedures that optimize initial TCP round trip estimates, such as T/TCP.
T/TCP is cited as an example of procedures used for optimizing initial TCP round trip estimates.
Each request carries a sequence number in the CSeq header, incremented by one for each distinct request transmitted.
items.constraint: incremented by one for each distinct request transmitted

items.meaning: A request repeated because of lack of acknowledgement MUST carry the original sequence number, which is not incremented.
items.condition: If a request is repeated because of lack of acknowledgement

items.meaning: Systems implementing RTSP MUST support carrying RTSP over TCP.
items.condition: Systems implementing RTSP

items.meaning: Systems implementing RTSP MAY support UDP.
items.condition: Systems implementing RTSP

items.meaning: The default port for the RTSP server is 554 for both UDP and TCP.
items.constraint: default port is 554 for both UDP and TCP

items.meaning: Multiple RTSP packets destined for the same control end point may be packed into a single lower-layer PDU or encapsulated into a TCP stream.
items.constraint: may be packed into a single lower-layer PDU or encapsulated into a TCP stream

items.meaning: RTSP data MAY be interleaved with RTP and RTCP packets.
An RTSP message MUST contain a Content-Length header whenever that message contains a payload.
items.condition: whenever that message contains a payload

items.meaning: Otherwise, an RTSP packet is terminated with an empty line immediately following the last message header.
items.constraint: terminated with an empty line immediately following the last message header

items.meaning: The method token indicates the method to be performed on the resource identified by the Request-URI.
The method is case-sensitive.
items.constraint: case-sensitive

items.meaning: New methods may be defined in the future.
Method names may not start with a $ character (decimal 24).
Method names must be a token.
DESCRIBE 方法的方向为 C->S，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 recommended。
items.constraint: direction C->S; object P,S; requirement recommended

items.meaning: ANNOUNCE 方法的方向为 C->S、S->C，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 optional。
items.constraint: direction C->S, S->C; object P,S; requirement optional

items.meaning: GET_PARAMETER 方法的方向为 C->S、S->C，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 optional。
items.constraint: direction C->S, S->C; object P,S; requirement optional

items.meaning: OPTIONS 方法的方向为 C->S、S->C，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 required，其中 S->C 为 optional。
items.constraint: direction C->S, S->C; object P,S; requirement required (S->C: optional)

items.meaning: PAUSE 方法的方向为 C->S，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 recommended。
items.constraint: direction C->S; object P,S; requirement recommended

items.meaning: PLAY 方法的方向为 C->S，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 required。
items.constraint: direction C->S; object P,S; requirement required

items.meaning: RECORD 方法的方向为 C->S，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 optional。
items.constraint: direction C->S; object P,S; requirement optional

items.meaning: REDIRECT 方法的方向为 S->C，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 optional。
items.constraint: direction S->C; object P,S; requirement optional

items.meaning: SETUP 方法的方向为 C->S，作用对象为 S，要求级别为 required。
items.constraint: direction C->S; object S; requirement required

items.meaning: SET_PARAMETER 方法的方向为 C->S、S->C，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 optional。
items.constraint: direction C->S, S->C; object P,S; requirement optional

items.meaning: TEARDOWN 方法的方向为 C->S，作用对象为 P,S，要求级别为 required。
items.constraint: direction C->S; object P,S; requirement required

items.meaning: PAUSE 是 recommended，但不是 required；不支持该方法的功能完整服务器仍可构建，例如用于 live feeds 时。
items.constraint: PAUSE is recommended, but not required

items.meaning: 服务器若不支持某方法，必须返回 “501 Not Implemented”。
items.condition: If a server does not support a particular method

items.meaning: 客户端在收到 501 后不应再针对该服务器尝试该方法。
OPTIONS 的行为与 [H9.2] 所描述的一致。
items.constraint: behavior equivalent to [H9.2]

items.meaning: OPTIONS 请求可以在任何时候发出，例如客户端将要尝试非标准请求时，且不影响服务器状态。
items.constraint: does not influence server state
items.condition: at any time

items.meaning: DESCRIBE 方法从服务器取回由请求 URL 标识的 presentation 或 media object 的描述，且其请求-应答对构成 RTSP 的媒体初始化阶段。
DESCRIBE 可用 Accept 头指定客户端能理解的描述格式。
items.constraint: may use the Accept header to specify the description formats that the client understands

items.meaning: DESCRIBE 响应必须包含其描述的资源的所有媒体初始化信息。
items.object: all media initialization information for the resource(s) that it describes

items.meaning: 若客户端从 DESCRIBE 之外的来源获得含完整媒体初始化参数的描述，应使用这些参数，不再通过 RTSP 请求同一媒体的描述。
items.condition: If a media client obtains a presentation description from a source other than DESCRIBE and that description contains a complete set of media initialization parameters

items.meaning: The DESCRIBE response is not to be used by servers as a means of media indirection.
items.constraint: servers SHOULD NOT use the DESCRIBE response as a means of media indirection
items.object: the DESCRIBE response as a means of media indirection

items.meaning: Clients need an unambiguous means of knowing when to request media initialization information via DESCRIBE.
Media initialization is a requirement for any RTSP-based system.
The RTSP specification does not dictate that media initialization must be done via the DESCRIBE method.
An RTSP client may receive initialization information in three ways.
It is highly recommended that minimal servers support the DESCRIBE method.
It is highly recommended that minimal clients support acting as a helper application that accepts a media initialization file from standard input, command line, and/or other appropriate means.
When sent from client to server, ANNOUNCE posts the description of a presentation or media object identified by the request URL to a server.
When sent from server to client, ANNOUNCE updates the session description in real-time.
